name: NeuroKit2
runtime_deps: numpy>=2.0 (0.2.13), pandas<3, scipy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, PyWavelets; optional ts2vg (emrich2023 detector), pyrqa (complexity_rqa method='pyrqa')
paper_citation: Makowski et al., Behav Res Methods 2021
method: ecg_clean (8 filter recipes) -> ecg_peaks (16 R-peak detectors incl. ProMAC consensus, optional Lipponen-Tarvainen artifact correction) -> ecg_delineate (peak/derivative, CWT, DWT, peak-prominence [Emrich 2024]) -> ecg_phase, ecg_quality, signal_rate; HRV time / frequency / nonlinear / RQA from R-peaks or RR intervals

input.shape: 1-D list / np.ndarray / pd.Series (n_samples,) for ECG functions; HRV functions take R-peak sample indices, the ecg_peaks info dict / signals DataFrame, or a dict with 'RRI' (ms) and 'RRI_Time' (s)
input.fs_supported: any (user supplied); no hard check except khamis2016 (raises if < 50 Hz)
input.fs_notes: Every function defaults to sampling_rate=1000, so it must always be passed explicitly. ecg_clean: 'neurokit' = 0.5 Hz high-pass Butterworth (order 5) + powerline moving-average filter (powerline=50 default; kernel int(fs/50) samples if fs>=100, else 2); 'biosppy' = FIR band-pass 0.67-45 Hz with 1.5*fs taps (filtfilt); 'pantompkins1985' 5-15 Hz, 'hamilton2002' 8-16 Hz, 'elgendi2010' 8-20 Hz Butterworth band-pass; 'engzeemod2012' 48-52 Hz band-stop; 'vg'/'emrich2023' 4 Hz high-pass; christov2004 / ssf / zong2003 / kalidas2017 do no cleaning. signal_filter only *warns* (NeuroKitWarning) when fs <= 2*cutoff, it does not raise. Detector-specific: khamis2016 raises Exception for fs < 50 Hz and uses 0.7 Hz HP / 20 Hz LP order-7 Butterworth; zong2003 needs >= 10*fs samples (10 s) else warns and returns no peaks; manikandan2012 uses a 2.5 s moving average (comment cites 360 Hz/500 Hz originals); rodrigues2021 threshold Pth = 0.7*fs/128 + 2.7 (comment: Pth=3 optimal for fs=250); kalidas2017 SWT db3 level 3 + 0.01-10 Hz band-pass; emrich2023 needs the ts2vg package, 2 s windows. ecg_delineate method='dwt' internally resamples the cleaned signal to analysis_sampling_rate=2000 Hz and maps points back; its search parameters scale with (fs/250)/(HR/60). method='cwt' uses fixed pywt CWT scales [1,2,4,8,16] ('gaus1') regardless of fs, with 0.1*fs half-wave search windows. method='prominence' converts ms limits (max_qrs_interval=180, max_pr_interval=300, max_r_rise_time=120, typical_st_segment=150, P/R/T basepoint 100/100/200 ms) to samples using fs. ecg_quality zhao2018 uses Welch bands up to 40 Hz (pSQI 5-15/5-40 Hz, basSQI 0-1/0-40 Hz, window=1024) so fs > 80 Hz is implied. hrv_frequency interpolates RR at interpolation_rate=100 Hz (independent of ECG fs). 0.2.13 changelog: some ecg_peaks methods now accept float fs (#1153).
input.duration_notes: No global minimum. Hard limits found in code: zong2003 R-peak detector needs >= 10 s; ecg_analyze switches to interval-related analysis when duration >= 10 s (else event-related); hrv_time SDANN1/2/5 and SDNNI1/2/5 return NaN unless >= 3 windows (docstring: 3, 6, 15 min); hrv_nonlinear DFA returns NaN for < 12 RR intervals and DFA_alpha2 requires (n_beats+1)/10 >= 13 (~>=129 beats); hrv_frequency docstring recommends >= 1, 2 and 5 min for HF, LF and LF/HF; bands that fall below the Welch frequency resolution (default min_frequency = 2*fs_interp/(N/2)) integrate to zero and are returned as NaN with a 'too short' warning. DWT/CWT/peak delineation needs >= 2 R peaks (ecg_segment window from mean HR).
input.amplitude_units: unit-agnostic (no mV thresholds in ECG cleaning/detection/delineation; relative thresholds only)
input.preprocessing: ecg_clean (see fs_notes) with NaN forward-fill (0.2.12) / signal_fillmissing (0.2.13); ecg_process = ecg_clean -> ecg_peaks(correct_artifacts=True) -> signal_rate -> ecg_quality -> ecg_delineate (default dwt) -> ecg_phase; ecg_peaks optional Kubios-style artifact correction (signal_fixpeaks, Lipponen & Tarvainen 2019); nk.ecg_invert for inverted signals
input.batch: one single-channel record per call (no multi-lead or batch API; loop over leads and records)

output.format: pandas DataFrame (per-sample columns with 0/1 event markers, or one-row feature tables) + dict of sample indices

name: BioSPPy
runtime_deps: numpy, scipy, matplotlib, scikit-learn, h5py, bidict, shortuuid, six, joblib, opencv-python, pywavelets, mock; peakutils (imported by signals/ecg.py but missing from the 2.2.4 wheel metadata)
method: Fixed FIR band-pass (0.67-45 Hz) -> R-peak segmenter (Hamilton default; ASI, Gamboa, Engelse-Zeelenberg, SSF, Pan-Tompkins++; Christov callable directly) -> R-peak correction to local max (+-50 ms) -> heartbeat templates (-0.2..+0.4 s) -> rule-based P/Q/S/T positions from local extrema of each template; separate HRV module and SQIs

input.shape: 1-D array (n_samples,); getP/Q/S/TPositions take the ReturnTuple produced by biosppy.signals.ecg.ecg(); hrv() takes rpeaks (indices) or rri (ms)
input.fs_param: sampling_rate (ecg(), segmenters, hrv); fs (bSQI, fSQI, ZZ2018)
input.fs_supported: any > 90 Hz for ecg() (45 Hz FIR cut-off must be below Nyquist)
input.fs_notes: ecg() FIR band-pass [0.67, 45] Hz with order int(1.5*fs) (forced odd) via scipy firwin + filtfilt; firwin rejects cut-offs >= Nyquist, so fs must exceed 90 Hz. hamilton_segmenter adds 4th-order Butterworth LP 25 Hz + HP 3 Hz and uses an 8 s initialisation (shortened to the signal duration if shorter). Pan_Tompkins_Plus_Plus special-cases fs == 200 (5-12 Hz) but that branch calls signal.butter on the numpy input array (name shadowing) and will raise AttributeError; other fs use a 5-18 Hz 3rd-order Butterworth and a derivative kernel interpolated by 160/fs. ASI_segmenter uses N = round(3*fs/128) with fixed Pth=5. SSF uses an absolute threshold=20 (amplitude dependent). engzee threshold=0.48. All windows are expressed in seconds and converted with fs; no internal resampling. Module docstring: 'Implemented code assumes a single-channel Lead I like ECG signal.' get_heart_rate discards HR outside 40-200 bpm.
input.duration_notes: ecg(): filtfilt with ~1.5*fs FIR taps needs > ~4.5 s of signal (scipy padlen = 3*numtaps). Templates require 0.2 s before / 0.4 s after an R peak; edge beats are dropped and the returned rpeaks are only those with full templates. quality.ecg_sqi_level3 raises if < 5 s ('should have 10 seconds'); ZZ2018 docstring: designed for 10 s. hrv: time-domain needs >= 10 s (raises otherwise; hr_*, rr_*, rmssd), nn50/pnn50 need >= 20 s, sdnn >= 60 s, hti/tinn >= 90 s; frequency domain >= 20 s; nonlinear (poincare, sampen) >= 90 s and appen >= 800 RR intervals; parameters='all' sets duration=inf and bypasses these gates.
input.amplitude_units: mostly unit-agnostic; ssf_segmenter threshold=20 and pSQI f_thr=0.01 'mV / sample' are absolute; ZZ2018 docstring expects mV
input.preprocessing: ecg(): FIR 0.67-45 Hz band-pass + DC removal, R-peak correction (argmax within +-0.05 s), smoothed HR; hrv(): RR outlier interpolation (rri_correction, threshold 250 ms) by default and smoothness-priors detrending (detrend_rri=True); frequency domain cubic-interpolates RR at 4 Hz
input.batch: one single-channel record per call

name: pecg (PhysioZoo ECG)
install: pip install pecg wfdb  (+ MATLAB Runtime R2021a (9.10) for wavedet)
language: Python + bundled compiled C (epltd) and compiled MATLAB (wavedet)
runtime_deps: numpy, mne (declared); scipy, wfdb (needed, wfdb not declared); MATLAB Runtime R2021a for wavedet; bundled Linux binaries (Windows via WSL / .exe)
paper_citation: Gendelman et al., 'PhysioZoo ECG: Digital electrocardiography biomarkers to assess cardiac conduction', CinC 2021
method: Optional notch (mne) + zero-phase Butterworth band-pass 0.67-100 Hz; R peaks by epltd (compiled C, Pan-Tompkins family), jqrs or wfdb XQRS; fiducials by wavedet (Martinez et al. 2004 wavelet delineator, compiled MATLAB); 14 interval and 8 wave biomarkers per beat per lead with 6 summary statistics.

input.shape: ndarray (n_samples,) or (n_samples, n_leads) - code unpacks [ecg_len, ecg_num] = signal.shape and indexes signal[:, i], although docstrings say (L, N); load_example returns wfdb.rdsamp (samples x leads)
input.fs_supported: any positive (WrongParameter if <= 0); epltd internally converts to 200 Hz
input.fs_notes: epltd: bundled C code has SAMPLE_RATE 200 and resamples the input record to 200 Hz via NextSample (signal first written as WFDB fmt 16, units mV, padded with its first 5 s). bpfilt: Butterworth order 75 (SOS) 0.67-100 Hz; if fs <= 200 Hz only the 0.67 Hz high-pass is applied. jqrs integration window round(7*fs/256). wavedet receives fs on the command line.
input.duration_notes: _check_shape_ asserts len(signal) > 5*fs ('Signal must be at list five seconds') in FiducialPoints, Biomarkers and Preprocessing
input.amplitude_units: mV (written to WFDB with units mV for epltd/jqrs/xqrs; amplitude biomarkers in input units)
input.preprocessing: Preprocessing(signal, fs).notch(n_freq=50|60) and .bpfilt() (0.67-100 Hz); bSQI quality index
